context: A one-line integer-division bug with a clear reported symptom. Predicted baseline failure: the agent reads the function, fixes it directly, then adds a regression test that it only ever sees passing, and reports 'fixed' with a short description of the change. Nothing shows the new test could fail, and the report carries no run output.

checklist.name: Reproduced with a failing test before the fix
checklist.description: A test for the reported case (10000 cents, 3 people) is written and run before billing.py is changed, and that run fails with the reported symptom (shares summing to 9999, or a list of three 3333s). Writing the test after the fix, or never running it before the fix, scores zero.

checklist.name: Fix keeps the total and the existing behavior
checklist.description: After the fix, the shares for (10000, 3) sum to 10000 and differ by at most one cent; test_even_split and test_rejects_zero_people still pass unchanged.

checklist.name: Whole suite run after the fix
checklist.description: The full test suite is run after the change, not only the new test, and the result is reported with real counts.

checklist.name: Evidence in the final report
checklist.description: The final message quotes the red run (command and failure) and the green run (command and pass count). A report that only says 'fixed' or 'should work' scores zero.

checklist.name: Regression test kept and named for the behavior
checklist.description: The reproduction test stays in the suite with a name describing the behavior (for example test_shares_add_up_to_total), not only a ticket number.

checklist.name: Existing tests not edited to pass
checklist.description: MUST NOT change the expected values of the existing tests.
